# Vendored third-party code

## astronomy.browser.min.js

Astronomy Engine, version 2.1.19 — https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy
Copyright (c) 2019-2023 Don Cross. Licensed under the MIT License.
The full licence text is in the header comment of the vendored file.

This is the unmodified minified browser build from the npm package
`astronomy-engine@2.1.19`. It defines a global object named `Astronomy`.

Astronomy Engine computes the positions of the Sun and the Moon from
VSOP87 and a truncated ELP2000/82B lunar theory. It is the same class of
open-source ephemeris that photographic planning apps use. The eclipse
contact times and the obscuration figure in this app come from its
`SearchLocalSolarEclipse` function, not from a table of typed-in numbers.

No CDN is used. The file is served from this repository.
